config.experiment_name: CEG-1: Causal Erasure Graph on Qwen3-1.7B-Base
config.purpose: Where does dead information live: direct KV access, relay into later states, or no legal synchronizer? Position-controlled causal erasure via attention mask interventions. Codex strategic design (2026-09-04, .codex_post_crc1.txt).

key_design_choices: Fixed 4-line slot histories, not random generation
16 histories per rendering: 4 dead combos x 4 live stores
Custom 4D attention masks for causal interventions
Eager attention, no KV cache, full forward passes
6 intervention arms: OPEN, QUERY-CUT, RELAY-CUT, DUMMY-CUT, LIVE-CUT, SYNCHRONIZER
Continuous measurements: delta_I(h,h') = max_c TV(B_c(Ih), B_c(Ih'))
Fixture validation: OPEN mask must reproduce standard inference within TV 1e-5

predeclared_interpretations.no_dead_content_effect: Retract dead-histories finding; CRC-1 was explained by position, generic lexical change, or incompetence.
predeclared_interpretations.query_cut_collapses: Obsolete KV cells are directly reread by the query.
predeclared_interpretations.relay_cut_only_collapses: Dead content is copied into later token states via attention relay.
predeclared_interpretations.synchronizer_collapses: Denizen-executable reset word exists; reuse CRC to test closure.
predeclared_interpretations.neither_cuts_nor_sync: Residue is distributed or redundantly relayed. Stop Qwen history line.

verdict: RELAY: dead info relayed into later token states
